agency_name.description: The buyer/agency name as published; the value `agency_id` is resolved from.

award_date.description: The authority's award date — the event the shelf records.

confidence.description: Identity confidence of the contractor binding (1.0 for publisher ABN, 0.8 for a name match).

content.description: The composed narrative label; NULL on 100% of award facts until 2026-08-28.

contract_end_date.description: End of the awarded contract period.

contract_start_date.description: Start of the awarded contract period.

contractor_abn.description: The awarded contractor's ABN where published.

contractor_name.description: The awarded contractor's name; the only identification for ABN-less suppliers.

description.description: The published description; often equal to `title`.

external_id.description: The source-native award key: opencontractau `contract_id` (OCDS ocid, award-suffixed) or AusTender `contract_notice_id`.

observed_at.description: When the award was observed / took effect; drives episodic ordering and the `since/until` read.

ocid.description: The OCDS contracting-process identity, kept as PROVENANCE (lookup, citation, lifecycle-linker input), not an axis.

platform_project_id.description: Resolved civil-project tracking id (the primary coordinate; may be a minted stub).

region_code.description: The jurisdiction that published the award.

supplier_identification.description: True when at least one of `contractor_abn` / `contractor_name` is present; the award gate rejects otherwise.

tender_reference.description: The originating tender id where published (AusTender `atm_id`), the lifecycle linker's reference-match key.

title.description: The contract/award title; for some scrapers the only human label.

value_aud.description: The awarded contract value — the one declared measure.
